summary: Circularity concern (cycle 108 A2) is the main risk. Plan addresses it correctly by decomposing importance into three variants (full/activation-weight/weight-only) and applying verdict criteria to the weight-only variant (zero tautology). If only the full formula shows correlation, that's an artifact. Clean design.
